summary: Safety Insurance Group filed an 8-K reporting that the HSR waiting period for its previously announced July 23, 2026 merger with MAPFRE U.S.A. Corp. expired at 11:59 p.m. ET on September 14, 2026. Under the agreement, MAPFRE's Splash Merger Sub will merge into Safety, which survives as a wholly owned MAPFRE subsidiary. The definitive proxy statement was mailed to stockholders on or about September 14, 2026. Closing remains subject to other customary conditions, including additional regulatory approvals. Terms such as price per share, premium and break fee are not restated in this excerpt; watch the stockholder vote and remaining regulatory clearances.
